jobs.name: p1_G2
jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark oil sketch for a book plate, painted loosely on a toned ground over a bold brush-ink drawing whose dark lines show through on the main contours: thick paint where the light falls, thin transparent dark glazes in the shadows, visible brush marks, strong chiaroscuro, realistic proportions, grim and serious. Night, two thousand years ago. Seen from high on the rim of a vast deep cut in a hillside, looking steeply down into it. In the foreground at the top left, two ancient legionaries seen from behind, in crested bronze helmets with cheek guards and rust-red cloaks over banded armor, hold torches high. From them a long column of legionaries with torches winds down a narrow path along the cut's steep wall, the figures growing smaller and smaller as they go down into the dark; one carries a standard on a pole. Far below, the whole floor of the cut is filled from wall to wall by the top of something enormous breaking out of the earth: one long smooth pale curve of gray-white hide, ribbed with broad shallow folds, running on under the rock on both sides; only this curve of it shows, the rest is buried. It is dim, lit only by the torches far above. Torch smoke drifts and sparks fall into the dark. The orange torchlight is the only strong color; everything else is night.

jobs.name: p4_G2_head
jobs.prompt: A full-bleed illustration that fills the entire frame edge to edge, with no border, no margin and no paper edge. A dark oil sketch for a book plate, painted loosely on a toned ground over a bold brush-ink drawing whose dark lines show through on the main contours: thick paint where the light falls, thin transparent dark glazes in the shadows, visible brush marks, strong chiaroscuro, realistic proportions, grim and serious. Night, hard frost on a field beside a road. In the middle of the picture a dead man stands upright on his feet, slack, his arms hanging at his sides, his head tilted; a villager long dead, in a torn linen shirt and wool breeches; his face is gray, slack, blank and empty, the eyes gone to dark hollow sockets with a dull orange glow deep inside them, the mouth hanging open with dull orange light inside it. To the right an old watchman with a gray beard, in a slate blue-gray hooded cloak over mail, a round wooden shield on his left arm, drives a long spear into the standing dead man's chest; from the wound the orange light pours out. The watchman's breath smokes in the cold. The orange light is the only strong color; the rest is cold night and frost, slate and gray.
